author: Kənd Həyatı
description:
A cozy day in the village becomes even better with a warm plate of homemade pasta and tender beef 🥩🍝🌾 In this video, we prepare a simple, hearty meal using fresh ingredients and traditional countryside cooking.

The beef is cooked until tender and flavorful, then combined with pasta for a comforting dish that is perfect for a relaxed family lunch. Simple preparation and rich homemade flavors make this meal especially satisfying.

This is everyday village cooking at its best — uncomplicated ingredients, homemade food, and a peaceful countryside atmosphere. Beef and pasta come together in a warm, filling meal made to be enjoyed slowly with family. 🌿🔥🍝
title: Making Pasta with Beef | A Cozy Day in the Village 🥩🍝🌾
